baselines.doc:
Heuristic orderings, all computed from as-of feature-store columns (ascending priority = run earlier).

  Random                 uniform priority (20 seeds)
  QTF                    quickest first: historical duration dur_last_asof
  LastFail               most recently failed first: h_days_since_last_fail (never failed = 9999, ties random)
  FailCount              most failures first: h_n_fail, descending
  cbt_LastFail           LRTS cost-cognizant form: (days_since_last_fail + eps) * (duration + eps); for tests that
                         never failed this reduces to "shorter first"
  LastFail_tiesShort     lexicographic: days since last failure, then shorter first
  cbt_BM25               (1 / (bm25_test_vs_diff + eps)) * (duration + eps)   (LRTS cbt_IR_GitDiff analogue)
  ChangedOrNewFirst      tests whose own file is in the change or that are new first, each block in cbt_LastFail
                         order
  Oracle                 the run's real failures first, shortest first (ceiling; uses the label)

ablation_question.question: does C (change) or D (co-failure) beat the best baseline on FirstFail-old with a CI excluding zero?

transfer.rule:
Declared rule: choose the variant with the best TVM valB PR-AUC, then confirm on TVM testC. If the chosen
    variant is worse on testC than the pooled all-projects variant, confirmation has failed and the pooled variant is
    shipped instead. That fallback uses test information; it is disclosed, and the shipped model's unbiased evaluation
    is on repositories no model has seen (Phase 5).

gate2_reproduction.protocol:
GATE 2: reproduce the LRTS paper's history baselines with our own harness, then re-run them as-of.

Protocol (LRTS evaluation/eval_main.py, eval_tcp.py, extract_hist_features.py):
  universe     runs of the paper subset (artifact/metadata/dataset.csv); stages with > 50 runs
  features     per (project, stage), runs walked in start order; for run N the features use runs 1..N-1:
               failure_count, last_failure (1 if the previous run of the test failed, +1 per later pass, 0 if new),
               last_duration (0 if new)
  techniques   QTF            ascending last_duration + eps
               LastFail_Asc   ascending last_failure + eps
               FailCount_Desc ascending 1 / (failure_count + eps)
               cbt_LastFail_Asc ascending (last_failure + eps) * (last_duration + eps)
               Random         uniform priority
               ties broken uniformly at random; 10 seeds averaged per run (eps = 1e-6)
  metric       APFDc_uniqueBug with durations + 0.001 (stp.evaluation.metrics.apfdc)
  variants     All        every failed run
               FirstFail  failing tests that are not first failures (per project+stage, paper universe), are
                          JIRA-flaky (name ends with a listed class whose fix is after the run), or failed in only
                          some stages of the build are removed from the run; runs with no failure left are dropped
  run set      FirstFail runs are those LRTS's eval_main.filter_builds selects from metadata/dataset_filter.csv
               (failure condition OR transition condition); this reproduces the paper's run rows exactly
  TVM quirk    the published TVM FirstFail outcomes are computed on the *unfiltered* failure lists of the selected
               runs (they equal our All values run by run, mean |diff| 0.0008), while the other 9 projects remove
               filtered failing tests. We reproduce the published protocol (NO_REMOVAL_PROJECTS) and report it as an
               inconsistency of the artifact: with removal, only 5 TVM runs would keep a failure.
  aggregation  mean over seeds per run, over runs per project, macro over projects

Mode `as_of` changes only the history rule: run Q is applied to the state of run R iff Q.end <= R.start
(end = start + capped build_duration). Everything else is identical, so the gap between the modes is the effect
of the concurrency leak.

Outputs: reports/results/gate2_reproduction.json, data/processed/eval/lrts_repro_runs.parquet
Usage:   python -m stp.baselines.lrts_repro

fact2.definition: ftf = EDA first-time failure (no earlier failure of the class in the same project+stage by start time), restricted to runs after the per-project 15% burn-in and builds with compare data. new = class not present in any strictly earlier-started run of the project; edited = not new and the class's own file (exact suffix mapping) is in the build's changed files.

rolling_origin_baselines.doc:
Phase 3 figures from results JSON + the baselines' rolling-origin summary.

  figures/calibration_reliability.png   reliability curves (raw vs isotonic) per base model, testC
  figures/ensemble_error_corr.png       residual-correlation matrix of base models and ensembles
  results/rolling_origin_baselines.json baselines on every 30-day window of the last 30% of each project (val+test):
                                        macro APFDc per subset, pooled over windows (no fitting needed, so every
                                        window is a true out-of-time evaluation)
Usage: python -m stp.models.figures
